# data.docker_container_stats

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Reads one resource usage sample of a container (CPU, memory, network, block I/O, PIDs), like `docker container stats --no-stream`. The sample is taken at read time and changes on every plan.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `container` | `string` | required |  |  | The container to read, by ID or name. |
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | sha256 of stats_json. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version from GET /version. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion). |
| `id` | `string` | computed |  |  | Container ID. |
| `include_previous_sample` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Let the daemon take a second sample one second earlier so `precpu_stats` is filled and CPU percentages can be computed (Engine `one-shot=false`). Default `false`: one immediate sample. |
| `name` | `string` | computed |  |  | Container name, without the leading `/`. |
| `stats` | `object` | computed |  |  | The GET /containers/{id}/stats?stream=false response as a nested object, field by field. |
